compute.reported_as: Sec. IV (Testing the method): The few parameter choice adopted in Ref. 54 is used only to initialize the present most general 8W + 1 (by including also the optimization of H_MF(alpha) and Delta tau) parameter ansatz |psi_tau>. || Sec. V: in order to compare the stripe with periodicity W = 8 and W = 7 and the uniform d-wave solution, calculations on a 16 x 16 and 14 x 16 clusters are carried out with 16 x 16 different twists in the BZ. || Sec. VI: For this reason for U/t = 2 (U/t = 4) a much larger mesh for the TABC was used with 64 x 64 (32 x 32) different twists in the BZ, instead of the smaller 16 x 16 grid used for U/t = 8 and U/t = 6. [...] much larger cluster simulations are prohibitive at present. || Fig. 11 caption: [...] at the lowest T_eff (i.e. largest tau t = 4, 2.6, 1.73, 1.3 for U/t = 2, 4, 6, 8, respectively) and 16 x 16 cluster. [...] In these calculations, in order to reduce at most the stochastic bias, at each iteration a quite large number (> 3 x 10^5) of samples for evaluating energy derivatives was used [...] || Sec. V (half filling): However, tau t <= 1.3 has been chosen also in this case, in order to show the strength of this approach even when short time projections are employed. || Acknowledgments: I acknowledge PRACE for awarding access to Marconi at CINECA Italy, and Riken collaboration for access to HOKUSAI supercomputer in Saitama Japan.
compute.source: Sec. IV Testing the method; Sec. V; Sec. VI; Fig. 11 caption; Acknowledgments, arXiv:2101.07045 (compute pass 2026-09-16)
compute.note: parameters = 65 is the paper's formula for the most general stripe ansatz, 8W + 1 variational parameters, evaluated at the stated stripe width W = 8 (the number 65 itself is not printed; the formula is). Worklist row cites the journal URL (PRB 107, 115133, 2023) = arXiv:2101.07045 (S. Sorella, VAFQMC). No run time, core count, core-hours or per-run sample count is stated for any energy in the paper; the only sample statement (> 3 x 10^5 samples per optimisation iteration) is given for the uniform d-wave ansatz optimisation of Fig. 11 on 16 x 16, not for the stripe runs, so samples is left null. Cost-relevant settings that are stated: twist-averaged boundary conditions with 16 x 16 twists for U/t = 8 and 6 (32 x 32 for U/t = 4, 64 x 64 for U/t = 2, in the uniform-phase study); projection time tau t = 1.3 (U/t = 8), 1.73 (U/t = 6), 2.6 (U/t = 4) at the lowest T_eff; a single Trotter step parameter Delta tau optimised. Hardware only as acknowledgements (Marconi/CINECA via PRACE, HOKUSAI/RIKEN). The Supplementary Information (journal and arXiv v2, identical tables) tabulates twist-averaged (TABC, 256 or 1024 twists) energies per filling and U; this row's single-cluster value is not among them (VJ1 reading of the journal version, 2026-09-30).
